mapper.sql: ID, CHALLENGE_ID, MISSION_ID, ASSIGNED_DATE, REWARD_AMOUNT, CREATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT dma.ID AS ASSIGNMENT_ID, m.ID AS MISSION_ID, m.TITLE AS TITLE, m.SUBMIT_TYPE AS SUBMIT_TYPE, m.REWARD_MIN AS REWARD_MIN, m.REWARD_MAX AS REWARD_MAX, m.MIN_TEXT_LENGTH AS MIN_TEXT_LENGTH, dma.ASSIGNED_DATE AS ASSIGNED_DATE, ml.STATUS AS MY_SUBMISSION_STATUS FROM DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma JOIN MISSION m ON m.ID = dma.MISSION_ID LEFT JOIN MISSION_LOG ml ON ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID = dma.ID AND ml.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE dma.CHALLENGE_ID = #{challengeId} AND dma.ASSIGNED_DATE = #{assignedDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT (CHALLENGE_ID, MISSION_ID, ASSIGNED_DATE, REWARD_AMOUNT) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{missionId}, #{assignedDate}, #{rewardAmount})
